scope: Read-only source-reuse audit for the current Unity MVP. No OSS code was ported.

projectFit.capacity: ReservationPlanner already validates bounded overlapping reservations with deterministic resource lock ordering.
projectFit.eventProcessing: MvpProgressionGraph evaluates guarded JSON transitions and records idempotent evidence traces.

candidates.purpose: Smallest actual-source candidate for a future global service scheduler: choose among ready compatible logical teams by an approved incident priority while preserving FIFO for equal priority.
candidates.exactSnippetLocation: Priority Queue/StablePriorityQueue.cs:104-141 and StablePriorityQueueNode.cs:1-9; retained at .tools/game-source-research/2026-09-21/priorityqueue/StablePriorityQueue.cs:104-141 and .tools/game-source-research/2026-09-21/priorityqueue/StablePriorityQueueNode.cs:1-9
candidates.portEffort: medium: import five small MIT types with their headers/notices. The stable variant avoids FastPriorityQueue's arbitrary equal-priority ordering.
candidates.contextFit: directly_supported_for_next_gap: RequestWork currently selects only the first Ready compatible mission, and maxQueuedJobsPerTeam is data-only. A stable scheduler is appropriate once a second concurrent target request is accepted; it must schedule logical Mission objects, never rendered members.
candidates.recommendation: Best source-port candidate, conditional on adding an explicit service priority to route data and a second target. Do not use it to replace the current player-visible FIFO task queue.
candidates.verificationTarget: Focused EditMode tests: equal-priority ordering is deterministic; cancellation and reprioritization never duplicate/drop an operation; PlayMode: two logical teams still move/work/return as groups, never one command per rendered vehicle.

candidates.purpose: Reference for FIFO, reentrancy-safe processing if operations later emit nested domain events.
dependencies: the rest of Stateless state representation, trigger behavior, transition, callback, and resource types
candidates.portEffort: medium-to-high for package adoption; low only for a newly authored, narrow queue guard after defining ownership and exception semantics.
candidates.contextFit: near_match_only: MvpProgressionGraph already supplies guarded JSON transitions and trace idempotency. No observed nested transition/reentrancy defect justifies replacing it.
candidates.recommendation: Do not add Stateless or copy its code now. If a reproduced reentrancy bug appears, author a tiny local FIFO guard around the exact event boundary, preserving the existing graph as authority.
candidates.verificationTarget: A focused regression invokes a callback that requests another operation event; the outer event completes first, the inner event follows once, and trace sequence/revision stays monotonic.

candidates.purpose: Immediate logical-team turnaround/replenishment source: after a returned team reaches base, hold it in Replenishing until an accepted-simulation-clock deadline, then make it Ready. PlayerResources remains a bounded-resource reference.
candidates.exactSnippetLocation: OpenRA.Mods.Common/Activities/Wait.cs:17-54; retained at .tools/game-source-research/2026-09-21/openra/Wait.cs:17-54. Resource reference retained at PlayerResources.cs:101-165.
dependencies: Wait: OpenRA.Activity only for Tick/IsCanceling; portable subset is remainingTicks plus an explicit cancellation predicate. PlayerResources: OpenRA Actor/Trait framework, lobby settings, sync attributes, notifications.
candidates.portEffort: low for the 17-line Wait behavior adapted into MvpAgencyDispatchController Mission state; no OpenRA Actor, Unity Update clock, or visual member loop should be imported.
candidates.contextFit: directly_supported: returning missions transition to Ready immediately after Return route completion, so current service readiness has no replenishment downtime. The bounded countdown and cancellation behavior maps to an accepted simulation clock and logical Mission only.
candidates.recommendation: Top current source-port candidate. Preserve GPL header/COPYING notice if copied/adapted. Implement a named Replenishing state with deadline based on Director.SimulatedSeconds; cancellation/reset exits it deterministically. Do not use wall-clock time or create per-vehicle readiness.
candidates.verificationTarget: Focused EditMode or PlayMode: team completes return route -> Replenishing; paused/no accepted simulation time does not reduce remaining duration; accepted time reaching deadline makes one logical team Ready; ResetMissions clears it; no individual rendered member becomes commandable.

rankedDecision.selection: OpenRA Wait is the immediate small source-port candidate for returned-team replenishment. BlueRaja remains conditional on multi-target service priority; Stateless remains reference-only until a reproduced event defect exists.
rankedDecision.reason: The required click-building -> contextual call/support -> target -> logical-team moves/works/returns flow is already directly represented by MvpAgencyDispatchController, MvpAgencyDispatchView, and MvpTeamTaskController. The OpenRA countdown improves current service readiness using accepted sim time and a logical team state, without turning rendered vehicles into independent command units.
